<script>
(()=>{'use strict';
 function init(){
  const header=document.querySelector('body>header.modern-navbar-2');if(!header||header.dataset.torNavReady)return;
  header.dataset.torNavReady='true';header.id='tor-pcs-header';
  const nav=header.querySelector('.pcs1-section-nav'),menu=header.querySelector('.navbar-fullscreen-menu-2'),toggle=header.querySelector('.navbar-two-menu-button-5');
  const apps=menu.querySelector('.menu-big-text.home-text'),panel=menu.querySelector('.home-submenu');
  nav.setAttribute('aria-label','PCS support sections');menu.id='tor-pcs-menu';menu.inert=true;
  toggle.setAttribute('role','button');toggle.tabIndex=0;toggle.setAttribute('aria-controls',menu.id);
  toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');toggle.setAttribute('aria-label','Open navigation menu');
  if(apps&&panel){panel.id='tor-pcs-app-links';apps.setAttribute('role','button');apps.tabIndex=0;apps.setAttribute('aria-controls',panel.id);apps.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');}
  let open=false,overflow='',inert=[];
  function setOpen(next,focus=true){
   if(open===next)return;open=next;header.dataset.menuOpen=String(open);menu.inert=!open;
   toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));toggle.setAttribute('aria-label',open?'Close navigation menu':'Open navigation menu');
   if(open){header.setAttribute('role','dialog');header.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');header.setAttribute('aria-label','Site navigation');overflow=document.body.style.overflow;document.body.style.overflow='hidden';inert=[...document.body.children].filter(e=>e!==header&&!['SCRIPT','STYLE'].includes(e.tagName)).map(e=>[e,e.inert]);inert.forEach(([e])=>e.inert=true);menu.querySelector('a[href]')?.focus({preventScroll:true});}
   else{header.removeAttribute('role');header.removeAttribute('aria-modal');header.removeAttribute('aria-label');document.body.style.overflow=overflow;inert.forEach(([e,v])=>e.inert=v);inert=[];header.dataset.appsOpen='false';apps?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');if(focus)toggle.focus({preventScroll:true});}
  }
  toggle.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();setOpen(!open);},true);
  toggle.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['Enter',' '].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();setOpen(!open);}},true);
  function showApps(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();const next=header.dataset.appsOpen!=='true';header.dataset.appsOpen=String(next);apps.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(next));}
  apps?.addEventListener('click',showApps,true);apps?.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['Enter',' '].includes(e.key))showApps(e);},true);
  menu.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('a[href]'))setOpen(false,false);});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!open)return;if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();setOpen(false);return;}if(e.key!=='Tab')return;const list=[...menu.querySelectorAll('a[href],button,[tabindex="0"]'),toggle].filter(e=>e.getClientRects().length&&getComputedStyle(e).visibility!=='hidden');const first=list[0],last=list[list.length-1];if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){e.preventDefault();last.focus();}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){e.preventDefault();first.focus();}});
  const links=[...nav.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]')],targets=links.map(a=>document.getElementById(a.hash.slice(1)));
  function navigate(target){if(!target)return;target.tabIndex=-1;target.focus({preventScroll:true});scrollTo({top:Math.max(0,scrollY+target.getBoundingClientRect().top-header.getBoundingClientRect().height-16),behavior:matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches?'instant':'smooth'});}
  document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const link=e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');if(!link||e.button!==0||e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey||e.altKey||e.shiftKey||link.id==='pcsmap-trigger'||link.closest('dialog'))return;const target=document.getElementById(link.hash.slice(1));if(!target)return;e.preventDefault();if(location.hash!==link.hash)history.pushState(null,'',link.hash);if(target.id==='pcsmap-trigger')target.click();else navigate(target);});
  let queued=false;function sync(){queued=false;let active=-1;targets.forEach((t,i)=>{if(t&&t.getBoundingClientRect().top<=header.getBoundingClientRect().height+32)active=i;});links.forEach((a,i)=>{a.dataset.active=String(i===active);if(i===active)a.setAttribute('aria-current','location');else a.removeAttribute('aria-current');});}
  function schedule(){if(!queued){queued=true;requestAnimationFrame(sync);}}
  addEventListener('scroll',schedule,{passive:true});addEventListener('resize',schedule,{passive:true});addEventListener('popstate',()=>navigate(document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1))));sync();
 }
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* PCSUnited footer curtain v2: all viewport widths, with tall-footer access and reduced-motion fallback. */
(function(){
 function init(){
  const footer=document.querySelector('#pcsu-reveal-footer');
  const main=document.querySelector('#pcs1-page');
  if(!footer||!main||footer.dataset.pcsuRevealBound)return;
  footer.dataset.pcsuRevealBound='true';
  const nav=document.querySelector('header.modern-navbar-2');
  const mq=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference)');
  let frame=0,focusMode=false;
  function sync(){
   frame=0;
   const available=Math.max(1,innerHeight-(nav?nav.getBoundingClientRect().height:0)-24);
   const bottom=Math.min(0,available-footer.getBoundingClientRect().height);
   footer.style.setProperty('--pcsu-reveal-bottom',bottom+'px');
   footer.dataset.reveal=String(mq.matches&&!focusMode);
  }
  function schedule(){if(!frame)frame=requestAnimationFrame(sync);}
  const observer=new ResizeObserver(schedule);observer.observe(footer);if(nav)observer.observe(nav);
  addEventListener('resize',schedule,{passive:true});mq.addEventListener('change',schedule);
  document.fonts?.ready.then(schedule);sync();
  footer.addEventListener('focusin',()=>{
   if(main.getBoundingClientRect().bottom>footer.getBoundingClientRect().top+1){
    focusMode=true;sync();
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>{if(footer.contains(document.activeElement))document.activeElement.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'instant'});});
   }
  });
  footer.addEventListener('focusout',()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
   if(!footer.contains(document.activeElement)){focusMode=false;schedule();}
  }));
 }
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();
</script>
